head: fix/container-deploy-hardening-165

Substance correct and well-scoped; register complete and self-flags 3 deploy-safety risks. HUMAN_REQUIRED: (1) behavior change — migrate runs Django system checks so web hard-fails/restart-loops at boot if CACHE_URL unset in prod (CPS#147 E003, reproduced) — warrants human judgment; (2) no decide_merge_authority automation -> default HUMAN_REQUIRED. Tier HIGH self-declared, OVERSEER_CEILING=HIGH (at-ceiling). Blocking gates failing (worker must refresh, not overseer): 'gate' (Sign-off gate — signoffs/*.stamp stale vs changed files) and 'Validation stamps current' (all-phases.stamp stale); require-overseer-approval red. require-human-approval + require-tier-ceiling green. No merge/approval posted; applied needs-human.
